key_questions: Trey Sermon (RB, ATL) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?

3 skill players are Questionable (Michael Penix Jr. (QB), Tua Tagovailoa (QB), Jalen Coker (WR)). These resolve at the inactive release 90 minutes before kickoff — is any current price worth taking before that, or is the option value of waiting larger than the move you expect?
The forecast changed since the previous capture but is not flagged material. Does the market appear to have reacted to it anyway?
KXNFLSPREAD-26SEP20CARATL-CAR3 moved +0.145 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

The model disagrees by -0.193 on KXNFLTD-26SEP20CARATL-ATLBROBINSON7-1 (Bijan Robinson). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

The model disagrees by -0.075 on KXNFLTD-26SEP20CARATL-CARTMCMILLAN4-1 (Tetairoa McMillan). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20CARATL-CAR4 sits at a market price of 0.96 — a tail rung. The tail of the model's distribution is the least validated part of it. Is this rung relying on shape the model is known to miscalibrate?

key_questions: Ben Yurosek (TE, MIN) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?

3 skill players are Questionable (Tyson Bagent (QB), Jordan Mason (RB), Kyler Murray (QB)). These resolve at the inactive release 90 minutes before kickoff — is any current price worth taking before that, or is the option value of waiting larger than the move you expect?
The forecast changed since the previous capture but is not flagged material. Does the market appear to have reacted to it anyway?
KXNFL1HTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20MINCHI-MIN14 moved -0.190 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

The model disagrees by -0.164 on KXNFLTD-26SEP20MINCHI-MINJJEFFERSON18-1 (Justin Jefferson). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

The model disagrees by -0.148 on KXNFLTD-26SEP20MINCHI-CHIDSWIFT4-1 (D'Andre Swift). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20MINCHI-MIN32 sits at a market price of 0.11 — a tail rung. The tail of the model's distribution is the least validated part of it. Is this rung relying on shape the model is known to miscalibrate?

KXNFLTOTAL-26SEP20NOBAL-28 moved +0.175 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

key_questions: Eli Stowers (TE, PHI) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?
The forecast changed since the previous capture but is not flagged material. Does the market appear to have reacted to it anyway?
KXNFLTOTAL-26SEP20PHITEN-20 moved +0.185 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

The model disagrees by -0.089 on KXNFLTD-26SEP20PHITEN-PHIDGOEDERT88-1 (Dallas Goedert). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20PHITEN-PHI4 sits at a market price of 0.92 — a tail rung. The tail of the model's distribution is the least validated part of it. Is this rung relying on shape the model is known to miscalibrate?

key_questions: A.J. Brown (WR, NE) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?

1 skill players are Questionable (TreVeyon Henderson (RB)). These resolve at the inactive release 90 minutes before kickoff — is any current price worth taking before that, or is the option value of waiting larger than the move you expect?
The forecast changed since the previous capture but is not flagged material. Does the market appear to have reacted to it anyway?
KXNFL1HTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20PITNE-PIT10 moved -0.200 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

The model disagrees by -0.169 on KXNFLTD-26SEP20PITNE-NERSTEVENSON38-1 (Rhamondre Stevenson). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

The model disagrees by +0.092 on KXNFLPASSYDS-26SEP20PITNE-NEDMAYE10-225 (Drake Maye). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20PITNE-PIT29 sits at a market price of 0.11 — a tail rung. The tail of the model's distribution is the least validated part of it. Is this rung relying on shape the model is known to miscalibrate?

key_questions: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (WR, LAC) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?
Carter Runyon (TE, LV) is ruled out. Is the market's price on his replacement's usage already reflecting the redistributed role, or still anchored to a committee?

3 skill players are Questionable (Derius Davis (WR), Ladd McConkey (WR), Brock Bowers (TE)). These resolve at the inactive release 90 minutes before kickoff — is any current price worth taking before that, or is the option value of waiting larger than the move you expect?
KXNFLTOTAL-26SEP20LVLAC-24 moved +0.160 since first capture. Is that move explained by public injury news already in this packet, or is it information we do not have?

The model disagrees by -0.166 on KXNFLTD-26SEP20LVLAC-LVAJEANTY2-1 (Ashton Jeanty). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

The model disagrees by +0.089 on KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20LVLAC-LAC4 (TEAM_TOTAL). Is that a mean disagreement the market has historically handled better, or a genuine shape difference? Note the model was shown redundant to the market on player props.

KXNFLTEAMTOTAL-26SEP20LVLAC-LAC4 sits at a market price of 0.91 — a tail rung. The tail of the model's distribution is the least validated part of it. Is this rung relying on shape the model is known to miscalibrate?
